summary: Sh. Ali Mashhour provides a detailed Quranic exegesis of verses 22-28 from Surah Al-Mutaffifin, focusing on vivid descriptions of paradise. He explains how the righteous will be seated upon luxurious, elevated couches from which they will view Allah, their faces radiating the bliss of this sight. Sh. Ali Mashhour emphasizes the contrast between paradise dwellers who are permitted to see Allah and the people of hellfire who are veiled from Him. He then elaborates on the gifts granted to the inhabitants of paradise, particularly the sealed nectar—a drink of pure, essence-refined fruits—whose seal is made of musk, signifying that even the seal itself is a source of pleasure.
suggested_title: The Vision of Allah in Paradise: Quranic Description of the Righteous in Surah Al-Mutaffifin
catchy_title: What Do the Righteous See in Paradise?
